items.informal_name: Determinant Invariance Under Column Addition of Scalar Multiple
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → ∀ (c : R), (A.updateCol i fun k => A k i + c • A k j).det = A.det
items.informal_description: For an $ n \times n $ matrix $ A $ over a commutative ring $ R $, if column $ i $ is replaced by column $ i $ plus $ c $ times column $ j $ (where $ i \neq j $), then the determinant of the modified matrix equals the determinant of the original matrix $ A $. Formally, $ \det(\text{updateCol}_i(A, k \mapsto A_{k,i} + c \cdot A_{k,j})) = \det(A) $.

items.informal_name: Determinant Invariance Under Row Addition of Scalar Multiple
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → ∀ (c : R), (A.updateRow i (A i + c • A j)).det = A.det
items.informal_description: For any square matrix $ A $ with entries in a commutative ring $ R $, and for distinct indices $ i $ and $ j $, replacing the $ i $-th row of $ A $ with the sum of the original $ i $-th row and a scalar multiple $ c $ times the $ j $-th row leaves the determinant unchanged. Symbolically, $ \det(\text{updateRow}_i(A, A_i + c \cdot A_j)) = \det(A) $.

items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] (A : Matrix n n R)
  {i j : n}, i ≠ j → (A.updateCol i fun k => A k i + A k j).det = A.det
items.informal_description: For any square matrix $ A $ over a commutative ring $ R $, and for distinct indices $ i $ and $ j $, the determinant of the matrix obtained by replacing column $ i $ with the sum of column $ i $ and column $ j $ is equal to the determinant of $ A $. Symbolically, $ \det(\text{updateCol}_i(A, k \mapsto A_{k,i} + A_{k,j} )) = \det(A) $.

items.informal_name: Determinant Equality Under Row Additions of Scalar Multiples of a Fixed Row
items.type:
∀ {n : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq n] [inst_1 : Fintype n] {R : Type v} [inst_2 : CommRing R] {A B : Matrix n n R}
  (c : n → R) (k : n), c k = 0 → (∀ (i j : n), A i j = B i j + c i * B k j) → A.det = B.det
items.informal_description: If an $ n \times n $ matrix $ A $ is obtained from another $ n \times n $ matrix $ B $ with entries in a commutative ring $ R $ by adding, to each row $ i $, a scalar multiple $ c_i $ of row $ k $ of $ B $ (where $ c_k = 0 $), then the determinants of $ A $ and $ B $ are equal.

items.informal_name: Determinant Equality under Column Addition of Scalar Multiples
items.type:
∀ {R : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] {n : ℕ} {A B : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) R} (c : Fin n → R),
  (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), A i 0 = B i 0) →
    (∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n), A i j.succ = B i j.succ + c j * A i j.castSucc) → A.det = B.det
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ and commutative ring $R$, if two $(n+1) \times (n+1)$ matrices $A$ and $B$ over $R$ have identical first columns and for each subsequent column $j$ (from 1 to $n$), the entries of $A$ in column $j$ equal the corresponding entries of $B$ in column $j$ plus a scalar multiple of the entries in column $j-1$ of $A$, then $\det(A) = \det(B)$.
